SessionStart.command: echo '=== V-002 SESSION START ===' && echo '' && if [ -f .credentials.env ]; then source .credentials.env && echo 'Vault loaded.' && gh auth status 2>&1 | head -3; else PAT=$(git remote -v 2>/dev/null | grep -oP 'ghp_[a-zA-Z0-9]+' | head -1) && if [ -n "$PAT" ]; then echo "export GH_TOKEN=\"$PAT\"" > .credentials.env && chmod 600 .credentials.env && source .credentials.env && echo 'Vault RECOVERED from git remote. Loaded.'; else echo '!!! ALARM: No vault, no PAT in remote. Check CLAUDE.md Credential Vault Protocol. !!!'; fi; fi && echo '' && echo '=== SESSION BOOT ===' && cat MANIFEST/SESSION_BOOT.md 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '=== KALAXI DICTIONARY ===' && cat MANIFEST/KALAXI_DICTIONARY.md 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '>>> READ CLAUDE.md IN FULL — NO EXCEPTIONS <<<' && echo '>>> READ MANIFEST/SCIENTIFIC_CHRONICLE.md <<<' && echo '' && tail -50 MANIFEST/ACTIVE_PLANS.md 2>/dev/null
